boundaries: NEO MB and M0-M9 are internal system classifications, not official central-bank monetary aggregates.
Doctrine must remain distinguishable from empirical claims, accounting rules, legal status, and executable financial protocols.
External-source claims and quotations require source verification.
Tokenized balances, mutual credits, NOMNI, XCP, and CES representations must not be described as legal tender or bank deposits unless the governing legal structure establishes that status.
High-impact financial or legal actions require separate authorization, compliance, risk, and jurisdictional review.
